title: Fuel Level Sensor "A" Circuit
plain: The computer sees a problem with the fuel level sensor in the tank, the part that tells your fuel gauge how much gas you have.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Fuel gauge reads wrong, stuck, or jumps around
Low fuel warning comes on at the wrong time

causes.name: Worn or failed fuel level sending unit
Corroded or loose connector at the fuel tank
Damaged wiring between tank and computer

checks: Compare the gauge reading with the scan tool fuel level reading
Check the wiring and connector at the top of the fuel tank
Measure the sending unit resistance at empty and full
fix: Usually a new fuel level sending unit, often sold as part of the fuel pump module.
drive: The car usually drives normally, but you can't trust the fuel gauge. Running out of fuel can leave you stranded somewhere unsafe, so track miles since your last fill-up and refuel early. Get it repaired when you can.
test_first: Check the connector and ground at the tank, then measure the sending unit's resistance through its range before replacing the fuel level sender or the cluster.

title: Fuel Level Sensor "A" Circuit Range/Performance
plain: The fuel level reading does not match what the computer expects based on how much fuel has been used, or it changes when it should not.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Fuel gauge reads wrong, stuck, or jumps around
Low fuel warning comes on at the wrong time

causes.name: Worn fuel level sending unit (dead spot on the resistor strip)

checks: Compare the gauge reading with the scan tool fuel level reading
Check the wiring and connector at the top of the fuel tank
Measure the sending unit resistance at empty and full
fix: Usually a new fuel level sending unit, often sold with the fuel pump module.
drive: The car usually drives normally, but you can't trust the fuel gauge. Running out of fuel can leave you stranded somewhere unsafe, so track miles since your last fill-up and refuel early. Get it repaired when you can.
test_first: Watch the fuel level reading on a scan tool, check the float arm and sender for dead spots, and inspect the connector and ground before replacing the sender.

title: Fuel Level Sensor "A" Circuit Low
plain: The fuel level sensor signal is lower than it should ever be, usually from a short to ground or a failed sending unit.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Fuel gauge reads wrong, stuck, or jumps around
Low fuel warning comes on at the wrong time

causes.name: Damaged connector at the fuel tank

checks: Compare the gauge reading with the scan tool fuel level reading
Check the wiring and connector at the top of the fuel tank
Measure the sending unit resistance at empty and full
fix: Usually a new fuel level sending unit or a wiring repair.
drive: The car usually drives normally, but you can't trust the fuel gauge. Running out of fuel can leave you stranded somewhere unsafe, so track miles since your last fill-up and refuel early. Get it repaired when you can.
test_first: Check the signal wire for a short to ground, inspect the connector at the tank, and measure the sender's resistance before replacing the sender or cluster.

title: Fuel Level Sensor "A" Circuit High
plain: The fuel level sensor signal is higher than it should ever be, usually from an open wire or a failed sending unit.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Fuel gauge reads wrong, stuck, or jumps around
Low fuel warning comes on at the wrong time

causes.name: Corroded or unplugged connector at the tank

checks: Compare the gauge reading with the scan tool fuel level reading
Check the wiring and connector at the top of the fuel tank
Measure the sending unit resistance at empty and full
fix: Usually a new fuel level sending unit or a wiring repair.
drive: The car usually drives normally, but you can't trust the fuel gauge. Running out of fuel can leave you stranded somewhere unsafe, so track miles since your last fill-up and refuel early. Get it repaired when you can.
test_first: Check the signal and ground wires for an open, make sure the tank connector is plugged in and clean, and measure the sender's resistance before replacing it.

title: Fuel Level Sensor "A" Circuit Intermittent
plain: The fuel level sensor signal is cutting in and out or jumping around.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Fuel gauge reads wrong, stuck, or jumps around
Low fuel warning comes on at the wrong time

causes.name: Loose or corroded connector at the tank
Fuel sloshing on a worn sender

checks: Wiggle the wiring while watching the fuel level reading
Inspect the connector at the top of the tank
fix: Usually a connector repair or a new sending unit.

title: EVAP Purge Flow Sensor Circuit
plain: A few vehicles use a sensor to measure fuel vapor flow from the canister to the engine. The computer sees an electrical problem with that sensor.
symptoms: Check engine light on
No change in how the car drives
checks: Check the sensor connector and wiring
Check the reference voltage and signal at the sensor
fix: Usually a new purge flow sensor or a wiring repair.

title: EVAP Purge Flow Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
plain: The EVAP purge flow sensor gives readings that do not match what the purge valve is doing.
symptoms: Check engine light on
No change in how the car drives
checks: Check the sensor connector and wiring
Check the reference voltage and signal at the sensor
fix: Usually a new purge flow sensor or purge valve.

title: EVAP Purge Flow Sensor Circuit Low
plain: The EVAP purge flow sensor signal is lower than possible.
symptoms: Check engine light on
No change in how the car drives
checks: Check the sensor connector and wiring
Check the reference voltage and signal at the sensor
fix: Replace the sensor or repair the wiring.

title: EVAP Purge Flow Sensor Circuit High
plain: The EVAP purge flow sensor signal is higher than possible.
symptoms: Check engine light on
No change in how the car drives
checks: Check the sensor connector and wiring
Check the reference voltage and signal at the sensor
fix: Replace the sensor or repair the wiring.

title: EVAP Purge Flow Sensor Circuit Intermittent
plain: The EVAP purge flow sensor signal is cutting in and out.
symptoms: Check engine light on
No change in how the car drives
checks: Check the sensor connector and wiring
Check the reference voltage and signal at the sensor
fix: Repair the wiring or connector, or replace the sensor.

title: Catalyst Temperature Sensor 1/2 Correlation (Bank 1)
plain: The two temperature sensors on the bank 1 catalytic converter or exhaust aftertreatment do not agree with each other the way the computer expects.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Possible regeneration problems on diesels
checks: Compare both sensor readings with the engine cold, when they should match
Inspect sensor wiring for heat damage
fix: Usually replacing the sensor that reads wrong.

title: Catalyst Temperature Sensor 1/2 Correlation (Bank 2)
plain: The two temperature sensors on the bank 2 catalytic converter or exhaust aftertreatment do not agree with each other the way the computer expects.

checks: Compare both sensor readings with the engine cold, when they should match

fix: Usually replacing the sensor that reads wrong.

title: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor "A" Circuit Range/Performance
plain: The EGR sensor "A", which reports EGR valve position or flow, is giving readings that do not fit what the EGR valve should be doing.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Usually little change in driving
EGR may be shut off, raising emissions

causes.name: Failing EGR position or pressure sensor

checks: Watch the EGR sensor reading on a scan tool while the valve is commanded
Inspect sensor hoses or ports for soot and the wiring for damage
fix: Usually a new EGR sensor or EGR valve; clean clogged ports.

title: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor "A" Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
plain: The EGR sensor "A" signal keeps dropping out or jumping around.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Usually little change in driving
EGR may be shut off, raising emissions
checks: Watch the EGR sensor reading on a scan tool while the valve is commanded
Inspect sensor hoses or ports for soot and the wiring for damage
fix: Repair the wiring or connector, or replace the sensor.

title: Exhaust Pressure Sensor "A" Circuit
plain: The computer sees a problem with the sensor that measures pressure in the exhaust, used mostly on diesels to manage the turbo and EGR.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Possible loss of power or slow turbo response
Possible hard starting on some diesels
checks: Check the sensor reading with the engine off (it should match the air pressure reading)
Inspect the sensor tube or hose for soot clogging or cracks
Check the wiring and connector
fix: Usually a new exhaust pressure sensor and clearing the sensor tube.

title: Exhaust Pressure Sensor "A" Circuit Range/Performance
plain: The exhaust pressure sensor gives readings that do not fit how the engine is running.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Possible loss of power or slow turbo response
Possible hard starting on some diesels
checks: Check the sensor reading with the engine off (it should match the air pressure reading)
Inspect the sensor tube or hose for soot clogging or cracks
Check the wiring and connector
fix: Usually clearing or replacing the sensor tube and replacing the sensor.
examples: Well known on Ford 6.0L Power Stroke diesels when the sensor tube clogs with soot

Check the wiring and connector
fix: Replace the sensor or repair the shorted wiring.

title: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve "A"
plain: Some diesels have a valve that partly closes off the exhaust to build back pressure, which helps them warm up faster. The computer sees a problem with that valve or its circuit.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Slower warm-up or weak cab heat on some diesels
Possible loss of power if the valve sticks closed

causes.name: Failed exhaust pressure control valve or actuator
Valve seized by soot or rust

checks: Command the valve with a scan tool and watch it move
Check the valve for soot or rust holding it in place
Check the wiring and connector
fix: Usually a new exhaust pressure control valve or actuator, or a wiring repair.

title: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve "A" Range/Performance
plain: The exhaust pressure control valve is not producing the result the computer expects when it is commanded.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Slower warm-up or weak cab heat on some diesels
Possible loss of power if the valve sticks closed

causes.name: Sticking valve from soot or rust

checks: Command the valve with a scan tool and watch it move
Check the valve for soot or rust holding it in place
Check the wiring and connector
fix: Usually freeing up or replacing the valve, or replacing the pressure sensor.

title: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve "A" Low

symptoms: Check engine light on

checks: Command the valve with a scan tool and watch it move
Check the valve for soot or rust holding it in place
Check the wiring and connector
fix: Repair the wiring or replace the valve actuator.

plain: The computer thinks the exhaust pressure control valve is stuck open, so it cannot build back pressure when needed.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Slower warm-up or weak cab heat on some diesels

Check the wiring and connector
